1.$description: Charts in the admin console (dark only, like the desk). Validated with the dataviz skill's validate_palette.js against the window glass (#151515): - Categorical, fixed order, never cycled: all six in L 0.48 to 0.67, 3:1 or more on the glass, worst adjacent CVD delta E 8.4, normal vision 19.3. "Other" and context series are muted. - Ordinal (funnel steps, light to dark): monotone, adjacent delta L 0.06 or more, the dark end 2.25:1 on the glass (values are labelled in text beside each bar). - Sequential (retention grid, low to high): text on bins 0 to 3 is white (5.4:1 or more), on bins 4 and 5 ink (7.1:1 or more); every cell prints its value.
